description: This file defines a REST controller for user-related operations in a Spring Boot application. It handles user registration, updates, and retrieval, integrating with user services and Keycloak for authentication.

classes.name: UserController
classes.description: A REST controller managing user operations like registration, updating, and retrieval in the banking application.

methods.name: createUser
methods.description: Handles POST requests to register a new user, delegating to UserService.

methods.name: updateUser
methods.description: Handles PATCH requests to update existing user details, delegating to UserService.

methods.name: readUsers
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch a paginated list of users.

methods.name: readUser
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch details of a user by ID.
